text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan — passionate, hard-working, and ready to help with your customer persona and target market presentation.

I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and structured step-by-step processes. In a Warehouse models for a DTC brand project (p06), I built a dbt warehouse with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing, which supported 38 models and tests on 120 columns. In a Marketing attribution analysis project (p02), I joined ad spend and GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare attribution models and helped drive an 18% budget reallocation.

I’d be glad to follow your guide, use ChatGPT for research, and organize everything into your Google Slides template.
